_comment: Every value the four initialize calls write ONCE on mainnet. RULED values carry Gary's ruling; PROPOSED ones are not ruled and scripts/check-launch-params.mjs refuses to pass while any is null. Never edit a ruled value without a new ruling recorded in DESIGN-v6.md.

bank_treasury.source: DESIGN-v6 ruling 3: the CBOBTC Squads receives the 15%

vault_collection.source: the vault collection 'Central Bank of Bitcoin Vaults' (Gary 2026-10-07), created at road step 10 just before initialize with update authority MINT's ["mint"] PDA and no plugins; record its address here

charter_opens_at.source: needs Gary: the date the charter claim window opens (unix seconds)

sol_reserve_lamports.source: 0.05 SOL kept in the revenue address. RULED by Gary 2026-10-03 (Linq text: 2 - yes)

max_sweep_lamports.source: 10 SOL per sweep. RULED by Gary 2026-10-03 (Linq text: 2 - yes)

sweep_cooldown_secs.source: 6 hours between sweeps. RULED by Gary 2026-10-03 (Linq text: 2 - yes)

swap_operator.source: generated 2026-10-04 (Gary: 'you can create the swap bot key'); secret at bank/keys/swap-operator.json (600, gitignored). Replaces the unfunded v5 key 3QwQnwkr..., kept as swap-operator.v5-retired.json

lock_deadline.source: unix time by which all five programs must be IMMUTABLE (upgrade authority removed); set at deploy, and before charter_opens_at so nothing ever holds value under an upgradeable program. The alarm pages CRITICAL past it, and in production if it is unset.

cbob_release_wallet.source: Gary 2026-10-04: the full supply minted into a dedicated release wallet on the box (bank/keys/cbob-release.json, 600, in the nightly R2 backup). Not an initialize value: recorded here so the custody of all 2,100,000,000 $CBOB is a pinned, checked fact (round 23 L17; SPEC accepted limit 56)

max_boost_weight.source: Gary 2026-10-04 (chat): the largest extra weight any vote may give a $CBOB boost, the program's maximum. The vote sets the actual weight inside it

max_boost_epochs.source: Gary 2026-10-04 (chat): the most DISTRIBUTIONS (not months: anyone can trigger one by burning 100 $GARY, which Gary ruled is part of the game) any vote may let a $CBOB boost last
